storyCards.headline: Goodbye Stranger: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Supertramp's "Goodbye Stranger" reached #15 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #15 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 14 weeks on the chart.

Goodbye Stranger was released in 1979.
